name: PyDFT Molecule Lab
author: Acxel Orozco
description: pydft-based electronic-structure lab for small organic molecules and hormones. Runs bounded single-point Kohn-Sham calculations, reports HOMO/LUMO, gap, chemical descriptors, Mulliken charges and dipole moment, and draws molecular-orbital slices and energy diagrams. Includes E2, EE2, E1, E3, testosterone, progesterone, caffeine and reference molecules.
dependency_note: Inject pydft with Wheel Plugin Manager into target global (shared) or pydft_molecule_lab (private). pydft brings pyqint, pylebedev, numpy, scipy and numba. matplotlib is optional for plots; QAH usually bundles it. The plugin detects vendor/global and vendor/pydft_molecule_lab and does not run anything on load.
